order_placement_is_free.meaning: submitting an order to the book incurs no fee

fees_charged_only_on_match.meaning: trading fees are applied only when orders are matched and executed

expiring_orders_supported.meaning: protocol accepts orders with expiration timestamps and refunds expired orders to the maker without fees

post_only_user_is_maker.meaning: a POST_ONLY order results in the user being a maker and paying the lower maker fee

post_only_guarantee_violated.meaning: the fundamental POST_ONLY guarantee that users will be makers and pay lower fees is violated

assumptions: POST_ONLY orders are intended to guarantee maker status and the lower maker fee.
Expiring orders are removed from the book shortly after placement with a full refund to the maker.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of the maker/taker fee correspondence beyond the qualitative guarantee that POST_ONLY users are makers paying lower fees; the correspondence is encoded as grounded booleans.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the violates_post_only_guarantee impact; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
Maker/taker fee amounts (0.03% vs 0.05%) are not bound as numeric symbols because the selected impact is the qualitative guarantee violation, not the fee differential.
